boundaries.note: Aggregate heat and gas-removal histories for the historical thermal comparison. The station did not measure these effective inputs. Heat rates apply to the simulator inventory.

withheldBlocks.description: Reserved interior block; model development may use readings before and after it. This measures retrospective interpolation.
Reserved terminal block; no subsequent development readings. This measures an extrapolation conditional on the case assumptions.

scope: Retrospective, within-event test of the temperature and absolute pressure outputs of a shippingport-conditioned native whole-plant thermal startup. All original station data were already public in v0.16.0. The split was chosen from the acquisition times before scoring the revised model. No independent-unit or independent-startup validation is claimed.
limitations: Both reserved windows belong to the same previously published startup. Model development uses other readings from this event.

A developer had seen some early reserved readings while inspecting the public inventory before receiving the split. Those values supplied no inputs to calibration or selection of boundary times and magnitudes. This was a retrospective comparison.
The interior block is bracketed by development measurements. The terminal block follows the final development reading.
The generic prediction ends at 7.5 hours. Its comparison uses only matched readings from the first day.
The station averaging method, instrument error bounds and continuous reactor power history are unavailable. Its generator breaker remained open.

points.excluded: The report flags a probable logging error. Its recorder chart could not substantiate this pressure (PDF p. 3).
